item.title: Kern Dant named GM of KLKN-TV in Lincoln, NE
item.description: Standard Media Group, the parent company of ABC affiliate KLKN-TV in Lincoln, NE, announced the hiring of Kern Dant as the station’s new General Manager.

item.title: STANDARD MEDIA APPOINTS KERN DANTAS CHIEF REVENUE OFFICER
item.description: NASHVILLE, Tenn. – Standard Media Group LLC (“Standard Media”) today announced the appointment of Kern Dant to the newly created role of Chief Revenue Officer.
